name: Practiced Alchemist
body:
You have continued to improve your alchemical research while pursuing other lines of inquiry.

Prerequisite(s): Extract class feature.

Benefit(s): Your caster level for your extracts gains a +4 bonus as long as this bonus doesn’t raise your caster level above your current Hit Dice.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
